correctness.rationale: In the two-sided stationary Poisson renewal model, backward excursion age A~Exp(r) is independent of the event of no reset across lag t, contributing factor e^{-rt}. Conditional on no reset, (X0,Xt) is centered bivariate Gaussian with variances 2K A^beta and 2K(A+t)^beta and correlation (A/(A+t))^{beta/2}. The folded-Gaussian absolute bivariate moment gives exactly the displayed covariance as age-covariance plus a strictly positive within-excursion h(q) term. For b=beta/2 in (0,1), concavity and exponential moments justify dominated convergence: the first term scales b^2 Gamma(1+b) r^{-1-b} t^{b-1}, and the h(q) term scales Gamma(1+3b) r^{-3b} t^{-b}/2. The powers cross at beta=1, yielding the three stated strictly positive coefficients and Brownian contributions 1/4 age and 3/4 within excursion. Bounded independent quadrature at beta 0.6,1,1.4 agreed in sign and normalized asymptotics, but analytic dominated-convergence supplies infinite-t proof.
